protocol.label_selection: training fold frequency descending with lexical tie break
controls: two deterministic cyclic complete-label-set reassignments, separately within train and held-out folds
references: exact finite-sample random-label average precision conditional on score ties and label support
protocol.aggregation: macro average precision over held-out supported labels, then equal artist-fold mean
protocol.uncertainty: paired descriptive 95 percent Student-t interval over ten artist folds
protocol.decision: accept if the lower endpoint of scorer-minus-reference interval is positive

interpretation: A new-source collection-level check of the post-audit diagnostic. FMA genre labels and catalog text come from the same source; this is not a listener or generated-music evaluation. No outcome will be used to tune the reference or support rule.
